answer: Turn detection into a paid market. Anyone may stake onyx against a suspect identity; the target must answer within one epoch with verifiable work receipts, and a winning claim collects the clone's bond while false accusations burn the accuser's stake. Every fake carries a standing bounty - free money for hunters - and competition among them drives detection down to days. A farm funds defense per head, forever. The ledger becomes a ledge: honest agents stand in the open, while cloned activity shows a widening delta between claimed and verifiable work.
